test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How does algorithmic living affect thinking over time?

options.text: It narrows perspective and reduces openness

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explains that algorithmic living filters choices through predictive systems, weakening personal agency.
 
• It mentions that users are often trapped in feedback loops that reinforce existing preferences.
 
• Over time, this leads to cognitive narrowing, reducing openness to alternative views or new ideas.
 
• Thus, the impact of algorithmic living is narrowing perspective and limiting openness.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Enhances creative thinking – Incorrect, as the passage states it reduces openness.
 
• **Option 2:** Encourages scientific research – Incorrect, this is not mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Option 4:** Develops emotional intelligence – Incorrect, the passage focuses on cognitive effects, not emotions.
